Civil Survey & Design Officer - Cadet or Graduate Opportunity Available
Position Title: Survey and Design Cadet , Survey and Design Graduate ,  Survey and Design Officer ,  Senior Survey and Design Officer
Are you looking for an opportunity to join a rapidly growing industry, gain invaluable skills and mentorship whilst also achieving a qualification in surveying and design?
Are you an experienced Survey and Design professional looking for your next step?
Reporting to the Manager Engineering Services, and working closely with our team of engineers, you will be working collaboratively across Council to assist with duties including:

For those looking to join with no prior work experience, this role has been created to bring on either a Cadet , Graduate Officer or Qualified Officer - with Salary Grade and training expectations adjusted to fit the successful candidate.

Many of our cadets and graduate hires have obtained in demand skills, which help to form the basis of a successful career. Whilst it would be advantageous, you do not need to have previous experience and applications from school leavers are encouraged . Ideally, you will be able to demonstrate:
Knowledge or experience in civil design and/or surveying.
Applying interpersonal skills.
For those with experience and applying for our Senior position, the following essential criteria must be met:
Diploma of Engineering or commensurate level qualifications majoring in Engineering, Construction Management or Spatial Science.
Demonstrated experience in survey and design across multiple disciplines including road design, storm water drainage, reticulation and traffic safety.
Demonstrated experience in using modern surveying instruments including GNSS and machine guidance for graders, including calibration and maintenance.
